title: Pig holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 34 Q66 46 63 58' stroke='#c9d6e8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='22' rx='14' ry='16' fill='#e8484f'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='16' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff8a8f'/>
  <polygon points='72,38 68,42 76,42' fill='#b8323a'/>
  <!-- pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#f19ab0'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='80' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e07f98'/>
  <rect x='48' y='80' width='8' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e07f98'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='28' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#9c4a60'/>
  <rect x='48' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#9c4a60'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='50' r='21' fill='#f7b3c4'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='26,36 34,26 40,38' fill='#e07f98'/>
  <polygon points='58,36 50,26 44,38' fill='#e07f98'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='56' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f79bb2'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='56' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#a8435c'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='56' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#a8435c'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='45' r='3' fill='#5c2440'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='3' fill='#5c2440'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='44' r='1' fill='#ffd9e4'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='44' r='1' fill='#ffd9e4'/>
  <!-- raised arm holding string -->
  <path d='M60 62 Q64 52 62 42' stroke='#f7b3c4' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d='M22 64 Q16 68 14 74' stroke='#f19ab0' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- curly tail -->
  <path d='M18 72 Q10 70 12 64 Q14 59 19 62' stroke='#e07f98' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
